lines.text: Many learners say: I very like it.
Better: I like it very much.
Put very much at the end.
The first one! I like pizza very much.

data.why: Put very much at the end.

native.tip: Tiếng Việt nói “rất thích”, nên dễ thành “very like”, nhưng tiếng Anh nói “like it very much.”
native.caption: Bạn có hay nói “I very like it.” không? 🍕 Hãy đặt “very much” ở cuối: “I like it very much.” Nghe cô Ama đọc rồi lặp lại nhé! Luyện thêm trong app Lexkite.
native.comment: Đáp án: “I like pizza very much.” Hãy nói to một câu về món bạn thích, kết thúc bằng “very much” nhé. Luyện thêm miễn phí tại đây: {link}

en.hook: How do you say "I like it"?
en.tip: Many learners say “very like”, but English puts “very much” after what you like.
en.caption: Do you often say this? “I very like it.” Put “very much” at the end: “I like it very much.” Listen to Ama read it, then repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
